text:
raj: FYI hitting a weird onboarding bug — CLI ended up using an org token when a project-scoped token was set, which caused 403s for project-only endpoints. Repro below.

emma (DevEx): Steps?

raj: Repro steps I used:
```bash
# set both keys in env (what some sampleapps do)
export REDWOOD_API_KEY=org_ABC123def
export REDWOOD_PROJECT_KEY=proj_XYZ789ghi
# run the sample app or CLI call that targets a project route
node sample-app/index.js
# result: calls to /projects/proj_XYZ/... return 403, CLI logs show it used org_ABC123def instead of proj_XYZ789ghi
```

sylvia: Seen something similar last week — SDKs that keep auth cached didn't pick up rotations either. For long-poll streams they kept using the old token until process restart. CLI should definitely prefer project-scoped creds when project context exists :thinking_face:

noah: Are the env-var precedence rules documented somewhere? I thought precedence was: CLI flag > REDWOOD_PROJECT_KEY > REDWOOD_API_KEY > config file.

raj: That's the intent, but current CLI code checks REDWOOD_API_KEY first (oops). So when both are present it picks the org token. Sampleapps that export both end up shadowing the project token.

emma (DevEx): Quick UX idea: add a `redwood auth doctor` command that does sanity checks and prints clear warnings if multiple keys are set or IDs mismatch.

raj: Prototype output I sketched: 
```
$ redwood auth doctor
Detected REDWOOD_PROJECT_KEY=proj_XYZ789ghi
Detected REDWOOD_API_KEY=org_ABC123def
Warning: both REDWOOD_PROJECT_KEY and REDWOOD_API_KEY are set. Current CLI code will use the org token.
Recommendation: unset REDWOOD_API_KEY to prefer the project token, or pass --project-key when invoking CLI.
Suggested: run `redwood auth rotate --project proj_XYZ789ghi` if the project token is expired.
```

sylvia: :thumbsup: Also add a runtime hook for long-poll/streaming clients to drop cached auth when `auth:rotate` event is received (or on SIGHUP) so sampleapps observe rotations without full restart.

noah: I'll open a ticket to track parity fixes across CLI + node/python SDKs + sampleapp docs. DEVEX-4921: CLI prefers project key, add `auth doctor`, sampleapp error string + SDK cache invalidation. Assigning to myself, aiming for EOW.

ops-bot: ticket created: DEVEX-4921 — CLI: prefer project key when present; add auth doctor + sampleapp error message; SDK cache invalidation for rotations (assignee: noah)

emma (DevEx): Thanks — I'll add a one-paragraph warning to the quickstart about env var shadowing and include a short remediation checklist for onboarding guides.
